## Why

Wave-B batch `r11-documents-01` (`27 7 23 * *`, create-paused) — the seventeen-candidate ACQ-14 family lands as **sixteen registry rows**: five further CCOPS municipalities on the generalized `government_mandated_disclosure` connector, seven agency-policy publishers on the new `agency_policy` generalization of the shared OKC clause machinery, and four district self-disclosure pages emitting vendor-inventory facts. The sixteen generated ACQ-01 rows reconcile to the I8 §5.7 design ids: eleven in-place renames (`Proposed id` kept, `Reconciled id` recorded), five CCOPS rows already carried design ids.

- **`agency_policy` connector** (`connectors/agency_policy.py` — ONE registered connector, the `OkcDocumentConnector` subclass pattern generalized): `extract_documents`/`_document_context` gain an additive `source_id` seat path; `[connectors.agency_policy]` in `okc_documents_vocab.toml` declares the closed seven-seat `source_ids` + the unioned policy/statute clause predicate allowlist (`policy_clause`, `legal_instrument`, `statutory_citation`, `retention_period`, `use_restriction`, `sharing_restriction`, `authorization_state` — no use/deployment predicate by design; a policy document never asserts a deployment).
